errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The collection isn't a versioned one, or a parameter is malformed.

errors.name: RepoNotFound
errors.description: This mirror doesn't have the repository.

cursor.description: Left out when the page already reaches the last record.
Pass the cursor from one page into the next query to keep walking records.

main.description: Who opened each COB record of one collection in a repository, and when. Gives the same author as the first version in `org.tangled.repo.listRecordVersions`, for every record in one walk, sorted by record key.

author.description: The DID of the account that opened the record, the editor of its first version.

changeId.description: Git Object ID of the change that opened the record.

createdAt.description: When the knot wrote the opening change. Not the record's own `createdAt`.
